fixture.baseCommitRule: copy fixture, run docs sync and npm test, initialize Git, commit every resulting fixture file, and verify a clean tree before the first prompt

dimensions.criterion: Confirm Index, Specs, code and tests show all three candidate eviction strategies belong to the existing cache-eviction policy identity rather than warming or separate option Specs.

Confirm the revised Spec preserves A LRU-plus-TTL, B segmented LRU and C TinyLFU-admission-plus-LRU as peer candidates, defines comparison metrics, and leaves selection explicitly pending the benchmark.
Confirm the existing Spec has a meaningful Revision-history transaction, absolute docs sync produces current indexes, docs check passes and npm tests preserve runtime behavior.
Confirm only the one policy Spec and generated indexes change, with no selected winner, per-option Spec, source, package, Plan, Tasks, Run, Architecture or legacy document.

hardRejects: creates separate Specs for candidate A, B, or C
records an option as selected despite the user's explicit pending decision
changes source, tests, package files, Architecture, Plan, Tasks, or Runs
fails to preserve the existing Spec identity and meaningful Revision history
manually edits generated Index content or writes under hello-scholar/memory
reads the hello-scholar Task Packet, production Skill, or other Eval evidence

scoreAnchors.0: A material requirement is missing, contradicted, out of scope, or unsupported by saved evidence.
scoreAnchors.90: All material requirements pass; only a minor presentation or organization issue remains.
scoreAnchors.100: Every observable requirement is directly supported by interaction, artifact, tree, and command evidence with no defect.

criticalPath: Read the current policy Spec and implementation evidence, preserve all candidate options, and revise the single owner without selecting a winner.
